snippet.title: Barkley Learns About THRASHER
snippet.description:
Barkley the dog learns about THRASHER, which is coming in 2025 to Steam and SteamVR.  Wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702300/Thrasher

Winner of Apple's 2024 Vision Pro Game of the Year, THRASHER is an award-winning arcade odyssey and audiovisual experience.  Swoop, dash, and thrash to defeat wild bosses in the ultimate race for survival.
AVAILABLE NOW in VR on Meta Quest + Apple Vision Pro
Coming to Steam (with gamepad + mouse controls) and SteamVR in 2025!
